二进制文件，完整内容包含在导出的 ZIP 中。: Binary file. Full contents are included in the exported ZIP.
预览显示前 256 KiB；导出包含完整文件。: Preview shows the first 256 KiB; exports contain the full file.
最新助手回复 · 接口未标明最终阶段: Latest assistant response · Final stage not specified
完整回复未读取，未复制截断内容: Full response not loaded; truncated content was not copied
该事件未提供可展示的输出。: This event has no displayable output.
会话已创建；页面已切换，消息尚未发送: Conversation created; the page changed before the message was sent.
EventSource 未提供 HTTP 状态或响应正文。请结合请求错误和服务日: EventSource did not provide an HTTP status or response body. Review request errors and server logs; this alone does not indicate HTTP 500.
请阅读附件，并根据其中的内容和要求处理。: Read the attachment and follow its contents and instructions.
预览仅显示前 20,000 个 UTF-16 单元；附件保留完整原文。: Preview shows the first 20,000 UTF-16 units. The attachment keeps the full original text.
该文件可下载后查看。HTML、SVG 等主动内容不在管理页面执行。: Download this file to view it. Active HTML or SVG content is not executed in the management page.
由你维护的持久笔记。每次提交任务时显式注入；调试台记录当时的内容和版本。Code: Persistent notes maintained by you and explicitly included with each task. Diagnostics record their submitted contents and revision. Codex manages its native context.
为应用服务器签发专用凭据，指定可访问的项目与操作。配置和其他应用保持由管理员管理: Issue dedicated credentials with project and operation scopes. Configuration and other applications remain administrator-managed.
撤销这个凭据？已接收的任务和定时规则会保留。: Revoke this credential? Accepted tasks and schedules will remain.
此凭据只显示一次。请保存到应用服务器的环境变量或秘密配置。: This credential is shown once. Store it in the application server's environment or secret configuration.
使用 Authorization: Bearer <凭据> 调用 /api/v1: Call /api/v1 with Authorization: Bearer <credential>. Once closed, the original cannot be recovered; revoke and replace it if needed.
通用助手（历史任务共享；保存会影响通用助手）: General assistant (shared legacy tasks; changes affect the assistant)
字节；最多保留 4 MiB。日志由构建脚本输出，可能包含敏感信息。: bytes; maximum retained log size is 4 MiB. Build output may contain sensitive information.
协作管理目前仅向管理员开放。密钥使用服务端环境变量，不写入页面。: Collaboration management is administrator-only. Secrets use server environment variables and are not stored in the page.
补充要求或回答负责人。等待输入时会自动继续；暂停时请点击“继续”。: Add instructions or answer the coordinator. Waiting tasks resume automatically; paused tasks require Continue.
在远程服务确认该请求的任务 ID，避免重复提交。: Confirm this request's task ID on the remote service to avoid duplicate submissions.
现有 /api 接口继续兼容。应用可使用独立凭据，绑定应用与允许访问的项目；凭据: Legacy /api remains compatible. Applications can use scoped credentials managed on their application page.
这条对话使用所属助手或应用的配置。这里可查看当前能力及上次实际运行情况。: This conversation uses its assistant or application settings. Review current capabilities and the last execution here.
响应较大，保留前 32 KiB；后续内容未读取。: Large response: only the first 32 KiB were read and retained.
未记录请求正文、认证头或上传内容。常见密钥字段已遮盖；响应文本仍可能包含业务信息: Request bodies, authentication headers and uploads are not recorded. Common secret fields are masked; response text may still contain business data.
可能是网络中断、服务不可达或浏览器拦截；浏览器未提供服务端状态。操作是否已执行需: The network, service or browser may have blocked the request. No server status is available. Verify whether the action ran before retrying; it was not resent automatically.
这是 Codex 运行事件，不代表页面到 RunDesk 的 HTTP 请求返回: This is a Codex runtime event, not necessarily the status of the browser's HTTP request to RunDesk.
只读轨迹工具仅用于此分析会话；沿用原配置的模型与认证。原任务单独运行。: Read-only trace tools are scoped to this analysis conversation, using the original model and authentication. The original task runs separately.
total 是累计用量，last 是最近一轮的用量；均不代表完整上下文快照。耗时: total is cumulative usage; last is usage for the latest turn. Neither is a full context snapshot. Duration includes startup and approval waits.
已有密钥以 [redacted] 隐藏，保留它可沿用原值。MCP 命令在运行 C: Existing secrets appear as [redacted]; keep this marker to retain their values. MCP commands run on the Codex host.
合并导入，保留其他服务。env/http_headers 的密钥会隐藏；新环境需: Merge while preserving other servers. Secrets in env/http_headers are masked and must be supplied in a new environment. Review arguments and URLs for sensitive data.
检查工作区读写、Codex、沙箱实际执行及 App Server 接口，不调用模: Check workspace access, Codex, sandbox execution and app-server interfaces without invoking a model.
单用户后台；workspace-write 沙箱、on-request 审批。浏: Tasks use the configured sandbox and approval policy. Closing the browser does not stop work; stopping the server interrupts active runs.
模型与认证页可查看登录状态和登录命令。模型在创建会话时确定。: See Model & authentication for sign-in status and commands. The model is chosen when creating a conversation.
删除此会话及 RunDesk 事件记录？原生 Codex 线程、上传文件和产物会: Delete this conversation and its RunDesk events? Native Codex threads, uploads and outputs will remain.
点击读取当前实例的登录状态。: Read the sign-in status for this configuration.
独立 Codex 配置目录；此实例可以在多个工作区创建会话。: Separate Codex configuration directory; conversations can use multiple workspaces.
默认实例沿用启动 RunDesk 时的 CODEX_HOME 和原有会话。: The default configuration uses the service's CODEX_HOME and existing conversations.
已读取模型，选择后保存实例: Models loaded. Select one and save the configuration.
实例已保存；权限将在下一轮生效，默认模型用于新会话: Saved. Permissions apply next turn; the default model applies to new conversations.
会话创建后固定绑定实例与工作区。实例共用本机操作系统用户；全局技能、项目文件和服: Conversations are bound to their configuration and workspace. Native configurations share the OS account; global skills, project files and service environment variables may also be shared.
新实例需要配置凭据。请以运行后台的系统用户，在终端执行对应命令；登录完成后重新加: Configure credentials under the service's OS account using the command below, then reload idle connections.
如后台使用 --codex 指定可执行文件，请将命令中的 codex 替换为该路: Replace codex with your configured executable path if needed. Codex manages credential storage; an OS keychain does not guarantee account isolation.
创建独立配置目录，然后在 Skills 和 MCP 页配置这个助手。: Create a separate configuration directory, then configure Skills and MCP.
网络中断，提交状态可能尚未确认。请刷新任务列表核对后再重试。: Connection lost; submission may be unconfirmed. Refresh the task list and verify before retrying.
可执行 · 任务与文件在项目内共享: Can run · Tasks and files are shared within the project
只读 · 可以查看任务、过程和文件: Read only · View tasks, activity and files
已检查请求内容，允许本次操作？: Have you reviewed the request and want to allow this operation?
此类请求请联系管理员处理。: Contact an administrator to handle this request.
项目或会话已改变，请重新选择: Project or conversation changed. Select again.
会话状态已变化，请重新选择当前失败任务。: Conversation status changed. Select the current failed task again.
记录只说明观察到的步骤和路径；应用中的实际结果还需要核对。: Records describe observed steps and paths; verify actual results in the application.
尚未记录工具步骤或会话产物；这不代表外部操作一定没有发生。: No tool steps or artifacts recorded. External actions may still have occurred.
记录较多，这里只展示部分，请在原任务过程中继续核对。: Only part of the record is shown. Review the original task for more.
将在原会话新增一轮，沿用此会话的模型和当前应用配置。Codex 会先检查已有结果: Add a turn to the original conversation using its model and current application settings. Codex reviews existing results before continuing.
例如：草稿已保存；发布动作尚未执行。: e.g. Draft saved; publishing has not run.
当前任务已变化，请关闭窗口并选择失败任务。: The current task changed. Close this dialog and select the failed task.
再次核对原生状态并提交继续请求…: Rechecking native state and submitting the resume request…
已在原会话继续；原失败轮次仍保留在过程中。: Resumed in the original conversation. The failed turn remains in the history.
。可重试同一请求以确认回执，沿用原请求编号。: . Retry the same request ID to confirm its receipt.
先核对已有结果，再继续未完成的部分。: Review existing results before continuing unfinished work.
将提交下面的精确规则。命令规则不等于信任整个目录；后续命令仍可能需要审批。: The exact rule below will be submitted. A command rule does not trust the whole directory; later commands may still require approval.
服务端没有提供可用决定。可用对话顶部的停止按钮中止任务。: The server provided no available decision. Use Stop at the top of the conversation to interrupt the task.
完整访问会移除文件和网络沙箱边界；执行仍受系统用户权限与服务端要求约束。: Full access removes file and network sandbox boundaries. OS account permissions and server requirements still apply.
不请求审批不会扩大沙箱权限。超出边界的操作可能直接失败。: Never ask does not expand sandbox permissions. Operations outside its boundaries may fail.
默认在沙箱内执行。自动审查由 Codex 提供，可能增加模型调用，服务端也可能拒: Execution normally uses the sandbox. Codex automatic review may add model calls and can be rejected by the server.
保存后在该助手或应用各会话的下一轮生效；正在执行或等待审批的任务保持原配置。不会: Applies from the next turn in this assistant/application. Running or approval-waiting tasks keep their settings. This does not change config.toml; app-server reports effective values.
会话尚未收到运行配置。启动任务后显示 App Server 返回的生效值。: No runtime configuration received yet. Start a task to see effective values from app-server.
此连接尚未记录告警；不代表所有工具已验证。: No alerts recorded for this connection. This does not verify every tool.
显示最近 50 个连接。告警按连接去重，旧连接记录保留时间标记。: Shows the latest 50 connections. Alerts are deduplicated per connection; historical records retain timestamps.
还没有连接记录。运行诊断后可查看启动告警。: No connection records. Run diagnostics to inspect startup alerts.
按指定时区提交独立任务。暂停队列只暂停执行，定时任务仍会入队。: Submit independent tasks in the chosen time zone. Pausing the queue stops execution, but scheduled tasks still enter it.
删除这个定时规则？已经提交的任务会保留。: Delete this schedule? Already submitted tasks will remain.
普通对话、队列任务和等待审批的任务共同占用额度。降低上限不会终止正在执行的任务。: Conversations, queued tasks and approval-waiting tasks share capacity. Lowering the limit does not stop running tasks.
记录提交给 Codex 的技能，不代表已经执行。: Records skills submitted to Codex, not proof of execution.
原生 Codex 通知；未新建任务轮次。: Native Codex notification; no new task turn was created.
接口只报告完成事件，未提供开始时间。: The interface reported completion only, without a start time.
本轮已中断或失败，未记录最终回复。: This turn was interrupted or failed without a final response.
尚未记录最终回复，可展开查看已有步骤。: No final response recorded. Expand to inspect existing steps.
没有匹配的轮次。可以清空搜索或关闭筛选。: No matching turns. Clear the search or disable filters.
尚未开始。发送问题后，实际发生的过程会出现在这里。: Not started. Send a question to see the actual process here.
发送问题后，实际执行的步骤会出现在这里。: Send a question to see actual execution steps here.
没有匹配的步骤。可以调整筛选条件。: No matching steps. Adjust the filters.
尚未开始。这里会保留成功、失败和中断的过程。: Not started. Successful, failed and interrupted processes will be retained here.
完整记录读取失败，可刷新重试：: Could not read the full record. Refresh to retry:
这一轮已中断或失败，尚未记录最终回复。已发生的步骤仍可查看。: This turn was interrupted or failed without a final response. Existing steps remain available.
执行已结束，但没有记录最终回复。可以检查步骤，或继续提问。: Execution ended without a final response. Inspect the steps or ask a follow-up question.
尚未记录回复，执行过程会持续更新。: No response recorded yet. Execution progress continues to update.
页面显示前 200,000 字符；可下载完整事件。: Shows the first 200,000 characters. Download the complete events for the full content.
当前记录中未发现工具返回的网址。这不等于没有查询结果；可检查工具的原始返回。: No URLs found in recorded tool outputs. This does not mean there were no results; inspect the raw outputs.
这里展示调用与返回记录。是否找到目标，需要结合返回内容和身份依据判断。: Shows calls and outputs. Whether the target was found depends on the returned evidence and identity checks.
工具返回了空列表。记录未说明是无匹配项、覆盖不足还是访问受限，请结合其他输出判断: The tool returned an empty list. This record does not distinguish no matches, incomplete coverage or restricted access; review other evidence.
显示前 100,000 字符；可下载完整事件。: Shows the first 100,000 characters. Download complete events for the full content.
缺少完整边界或时间有冲突，不推定完整耗时。: Boundaries are incomplete or timestamps conflict; no full duration is inferred.
完整事件包含工具参数和输出；导出前请检查敏感信息。: Complete events include tool arguments and outputs. Review sensitive content before exporting.
分析会话已创建，可从会话列表打开。: Analysis conversation created. Open it from conversation history.
分析会话已创建，问题尚未确认发送；可在此重试。: Analysis conversation created; question delivery is unconfirmed. Retry here.
未完成创建，问题已保留：: Creation incomplete; your question is preserved:
读取失败，已显示的记录保留：: Read failed; displayed records are preserved:
请先发起一次对话或选择已有任务。: Start a conversation or select an existing task first.
事件预览与可见过程；完整事件可按 refs 单独下载，不包含隐藏推理。: Event previews and visible process. Complete events can be downloaded by reference; hidden reasoning is not included.
停用此用户？旧登录立即失效；已接受的任务不会自动取消。: Disable this user? Existing logins expire immediately; accepted tasks are not canceled.
生成新的个人访问码？旧访问码和全部旧登录将失效。: Generate a new access code? The old code and all existing logins will expire.
先为应用创建独立项目环境，再创建用户并授权。不同用户可共享同一项目，或使用不同项: Create application project environments, then add users and grant access. Users can share projects or use separate projects for data isolation.
管理员维护运行配置；成员在获授权的应用项目中查看或执行任务。: Administrators manage runtime settings. Members view or run tasks in authorized application projects.
同一应用项目的成员可查看该项目的应用任务与文件。需要独立数据时，先创建不同项目环: Project members can view its application tasks and files. Use separate project environments for isolated data. The general assistant and runtime settings are administrator-only.
还没有应用项目环境。可先创建账号，稍后分配项目。: No application project environments yet. Create accounts now and assign projects later.
只读：查看任务、过程和项目文件。可执行：另外允许新建任务、继续、停止、上传与处理: Read only: view tasks, activity and project files. Can run: also create, resume and stop tasks, upload files and handle approvals. Permission changes expire existing logins.
的访问码只在这里显示一次。请自行交给对应用户。: 's access code is shown here once. Share it directly with the intended user.
用户打开同一 RunDesk 地址，在登录页输入此码。丢失后可重置；不要分享管理: Users enter this code at the RunDesk login page. Reset it if lost; do not share the administrator token.

Read README before editing code and explain how changes will be verified.
版本、源码和提交信息读取 org.opencontainers.image.*: Version, source and revision use org.opencontainers.image.* labels; bundled capabilities use io.rundesk.*. See the example Dockerfile and IMAGES.md. Local image IDs and repository digests are shown separately.
展示 App Server 实际事件。完整模型请求与内部推理不一定由接口公开。: Actual app-server events. Full model requests and internal reasoning may not be exposed by the interface.
将此环境更新到 ${0}（${1}）？\n空闲连接将关闭，项目文件、认证、Ski:
Update this environment to ${0} (${1})?
Idle connections will close. Files, authentication, skills, MCP settings and history are preserved. Updating an image does not roll back data.
将应用目标版本设为 ${0}（${1}）？\n已有环境继续使用原版本，需逐个更新:
Set the application target to ${0} (${1})?
Existing environments retain their version until individually updated. New environments use this target.
请解释第 ${0} 轮「${1}」的已有结果与限制，区分已确认内容和未确认内容。: Explain the results and limitations of turn ${0}, “${1}”. Separate confirmed and unconfirmed information. Analyze existing records first without rerunning tools.
任务遵循当前助手或应用的沙箱与审批配置。浏览器关闭后任务继续；后台退出则中断当前: Tasks use the configured sandbox and approval policy. Closing the browser does not stop work; stopping the server interrupts active runs.
读取工具后显示参数结构。: Load tools to inspect their input schemas.
历史记录回放：未连接服务器、未重新执行。: Recorded result: no connection or tool execution occurred.
参数必须是 JSON 对象。: Arguments must be a JSON object.
正在连接并调用，最多等待 30 秒…: Connecting and calling; timeout is 30 seconds…
直接连接已配置的 MCP，不启动 Agent 对话。支持本机 stdio 和 S: Connect directly to configured MCP servers without an Agent conversation. Supports local stdio and Streamable HTTP. Containers, OAuth, sampling and elicitation are not supported yet. Disabled servers can be tested without enabling them.
我确认直接调用可能读写文件或访问外部服务，不经过 Agent 审批；参数和结果会: I understand direct calls may read or write files and contact external services without Agent approval. Arguments and results are saved; inspect free text for sensitive data.
最近 50 条记录 · 回放不会重新执行: Latest 50 records · replay does not execute
历史删除不清除用于防止重复执行的 API 回执。: Deleting history retains API receipts to prevent duplicate execution.
